subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India mentions that “there shall be a Public Service Commission for the Union and a Public Service Commission for each State”?
solution:
The correct answer is **Article 315 (1)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 315 (1)** of the Constitution of India states that there shall be a Public Service Commission for the Union and a Public Service Commission for each State.
 
• This article establishes the foundation for the formation of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (SPSCs).
 
• The purpose of these commissions is to conduct examinations for appointments to the services of the Union and the States.
 
• The commissions also advise the government on matters related to recruitment, transfers, and disciplinary actions.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Article 315 (4) deals with the provisions for the removal and suspension of members of the Public Service Commission.
 
 

 Option 2
 Article 315 (1) specifies the existence of a Public Service Commission for the Union and each State.
 
 

 Option 3
 Article 315 (3) allows for the establishment of a Joint Public Service Commission for two or more States.
 
 

 Option 4
 Article 315 (2) discusses the appointment and term of office of members of the Public Service Commission.
